title: Core-26 Lineage, Form, Progression and Social Completion
objective: Complete source-backed lineage/form/adaptation/progression and language/social/knowledge identity surfaces consistently for all 26.
acceptance: 26/26 have explicit applicable/not-applicable status for each optional dimension
Ratman subordinate lineages are governed without becoming peer core species
culture and learned language remain separate from biology
boundaries: Consume CORE26-CURRENT-01, CORE26.GAME_READY.v1, all v1.1.0 predecessor definitions/registers, MVPS19.CORE26.OWNER_DECISIONS.v1 and MVPS19.CORE26.MECHANICS.v1 before historical material.

Complete only lineage/subspecies, form/transformation, adaptation/progression, and social/language/knowledge identity surfaces; current identity and MVPS-19 mechanics baselines remain predecessor authority.
Ratman subordinate lineages remain subordinate and do not become peer Core-26 species.
Culture and learned language remain separate from biological communication and species identity.
Preserve the full existing Vespin stinger species system and bind progression/purchase semantics through shared Progression owners rather than flattening it into one generic weapon.

Traiga adaptations, Mythragara forms, Morganthyr ascensions, Stygian optional functional-wing state, and other optional dimensions resolve through common typed contracts without species-name runtime branches.
Missing source remains explicit unless the Owner supplies a canon decision; do not fabricate optional content for matrix completeness.
Appearance/presentation regeneration belongs to MVPS-21; balance/cross-system certification belongs to MVPS-22 and final game-ready golden proof to MVPS-23.
next_action: MVPS-21 is the strict successor. It must consume the current v1.2.0 Core-26 definitions/registers plus MVPS20.CORE26.OPTIONAL_DIMENSIONS.v1 and MVPS20.CORE26.SPECIAL_SYSTEMS.v1 while regenerating current-authority appearance, picker, authoring/search/inspection and presentation outputs without reopening mechanics authority.
